name: com.simplycleantoledo/toledo-cleaning-prices
title: Toledo Cleaning Price Estimator
description: Free ballpark cleaning prices for Toledo, OH and nearby towns, from cited public price guides.

tools.name: estimate_cleaning_price
tools.description: Ballpark price range for a cleaning job in Toledo, OH and nearby towns, built from published, cited market price guides (Angi, HomeGuide, HomeAdvisor, Thumbtack, Care.com, BLS and per-foot detailing price indexes). Services: commercial/office, residential (house), new_construction (move-in ready), post_remodel, rv (camper), boat, aircraft_interior. Use when someone asks e.g. 'how much does office cleaning cost in Toledo/Sylvania/Perrysburg'. Output is a market estimate, NOT Simply Clean Toledo's prices.

service.description: commercial | residential | new_construction | post_remodel | rv | boat | aircraft_interior (common synonyms like 'office', 'house', 'camper', 'remodel' are accepted)

city.description: City or town, e.g. 'Toledo', 'Sylvania, OH', 'Temperance, MI'

square_feet.description: Floor area in sq ft (commercial, residential, new_construction, post_remodel)

frequency.description: one_time | daily | several_per_week | weekly | biweekly | monthly

facility_type.description: Commercial: office | medical | industrial | retail | educational

phase.description: New construction: rough | final | touch_up (default final, i.e. move-in ready)

length_feet.description: RV or boat length in feet
